review: was an amazing game, decent monetization structure, and a less tence way to play arma. Playing this game didnt come with the barrier to entry that arma 3 has. Fun while it lasted

Argo is a great initiative, to bring together the more intense action-based Counter-Strike like community, with the slower paced TacOps community.

The different game-modes provide an excellent bridge between these two, and somewhere in-between anyone can find their favourite.

In my opinion, with Argo, Bohemia shown, that this kind of gameplay is also in Arma as a possibility, and for me it's just another example of the power of the community-based customizable world of Arma.

For ARMA players I recommend it as a relief from the more brain-intensive TacOps gameplay

For CsGO and Battlefield players, I recommend it as a gateway to the ArmA community.

I'm biased by the way... Fortunately it's free to try, so it's cheap to formulate your own opinion.

Argo is a good free to play game released by Bohemia, and having put 1000+ hours into Arma, this isn't the real deal, but it's pretty good. Some features are nerfed, not as functional, or just boiled down, but it's faster paced and entertaining, at the end of the day.
